documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its new 10-acre automated Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial growth for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing of textile binders and table gues under a technology transfer agreement. The company aims to scale manufacturing utilization to 100% by the end of FY27, increase the contribution of manufacturing to 50% of the revenue mix, and expand non-textile binder applications while maintaining a focus on reducing debt through internal accruals. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26, highlighting revenue growth and a strategic transition from trading to an automated manufacturing model in Vadodara, Gujarat. Management discussed expanding geographic footprints, broadening product offerings in textile inks and water-based wood coatings, and focusing on eco-friendly certifications.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall EBITDA margins to increase by 2% to 3% at full capacity.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching full capacity utilization of its Vadodara plant by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing revenue for the current year is targeted between INR60 crores and INR70 crores based on expected utilization.
The company expects to achieve full capacity of the new manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: In the coming time, manufacturing margins are expected to be near about 50%.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: At full capacity utilization, the 500-ton capacity manufacturing plant can generate a total turnover around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports by eliminating duties.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: With Bangladesh facing various challenges, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects 15% to 20% growth in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% growth in the wood coating market.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Further manufacturing capacity expansion through additional vessels would cost approximately INR3 crore to INR5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production has commenced at the company's first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, featuring an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The new facility's utility, cooling plant, and monomer storage capacity have been installed for further expansion without requiring more capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the total manufacturing capex, INR 30 crores is a bank loan, INR 10 crores was funded through IPO to purchase land, and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capex_expansion.claim: The expected payback period for the INR 40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capex_expansion.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile, with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the manufacturing segment are around 20% to 25%, whereas the trading business is at 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q3 FY26, EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR 7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices have not seen any significant changes in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first two months of manufacturing operations (November and December), the company utilized around 60% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: As of December end, the company's net worth stood at around INR 42 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The short-term borrowings carry an interest rate of 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Bangladesh faces challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach full capacity utilization of the manufacturing plant by the end of financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to increase the contribution of manufacturing to 50% of the revenue mix.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to launch new products resulting from R&D trials within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to selectively expand market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment.
management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by an advanced and sustainable textile coating facility by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity of the new manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans expansion within the next 6 months depending on domestic binder production and discussions regarding ink manufacturing.
management_commitments.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to establish a fully manufacturing unit and become a market leader by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: See, we will establish fully manufacturing unit considering by 2030. And try to become a market leader by giving sustainable eco-friendly solution to the textile as well as the wood coating industry.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
